text: FAA guidance: AC 107-2A states that if the connection cannot be reestablished, emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link should be started. The Matrice 210 V1 manual: when the RC signal is lost for more than three seconds, Failsafe RTH is automatically activated; the user can cancel RTH when the connection returns; the aircraft cannot return to the Home Point with weak GPS; it will descend and land if within 65 feet (20 meters) of the Home Point; Smart RTH can be started or terminated with the Smart RTH button.
